visualReview.scope: Current exterior reconstruction render integrity; maximum fidelity remains pending.
visualReview.notes: All16 current portable views inspected. Fixed the turret/main-wall gap, closed the window sills, corrected inward oculus normals and removed regular diagonal weathering. Whole-elevation cameras now include the mast. Current silhouette, recessed openings, elevated entrance stair, collar-wall study and roof geometry render coherently.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All16 current shared-material/placement frames inspected; brick-and-putlogs and north-up placement checked at full resolution. Six canonical graphs resolve once each. Metric brick joints, stone belt, wood stairs, metal grilles and concrete terrace are visible. No per-model bitmap textures are embedded. Model unload releases all geometry. Actual structure has irregular medieval brickwork and repairs; regular canonical brick pattern remains a fidelity limitation.

geographicReview.notes: The north-up flat-terrain frame matches the mapped main footprint and offset turret. Primary publication independently identifies southwest stair facade and northwest privy, resolving signed heading. Reconstructed collar-wall extent, external stair footprint, foundation datum and real sloping terrain contacts are not yet independently validated.

fidelityReview.notes: Main34.5 m crenellations are documented; the38.5 m stair turret,44 m mast, opening levels and5.8 m raised threshold are photographic estimates. Exact restored elevation datum, current roof furniture, stair dimensions and collar ruins require further measured evidence. Putlog pattern and brick repairs are approximate; interior rooms and distant terrace stairs are outside this exterior asset. Do not count this candidate as complete.
